mapper.sql: CASE WHEN l.status = 'DISABLED' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN s.checkout_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN l.expire_time <= #{now} THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE l.status END
FROM payment_link l LEFT JOIN payment_link_checkout_binding b ON b.link_id = l.link_id LEFT JOIN payment_checkout_session s ON s.checkout_session_id = b.checkout_session_id AND s.deleted = 0

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_checkout_attempt ca WHERE ca.checkout_session_id = b.checkout_session_id AND ca.channel_code = #{query.channelCode} AND ca.deleted = 0)

mapper.select:
SELECT l.link_id, l.merchant_id, l.merchant_order_no, l.link_name, l.description, l.merchant_display_name, l.currency, l.amount AS amount, l.currency_exponent, l.locale, () AS status, COALESCE(s.checkout_status, 'PENDING') AS payment_status, COALESCE(s.attempt_count, 0) AS attempt_count, s.latest_transaction_id AS transaction_id, s.transaction_date_time, l.expire_time, l.create_time, s.paid_time, l.created_app_code, l.created_by, l.disable_reason, l.version
ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT l.currency AS currency, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN () = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active, SUM(CASE WHEN s.checkout_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN s.checkout_status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.checkout_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_checkout_attempt fa WHERE fa.checkout_session_id = b.checkout_session_id AND fa.deleted = 0 AND fa.attempt_status IN ('FAILED', 'THREE_DS_FAILED'))), 0) AS failed_attempts
GROUP BY l.currency

SELECT a.checkout_attempt_id, a.attempt_no, a.transaction_id, a.transaction_date_time, CASE WHEN a.attempt_status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN a.attempt_status IN ('FAILED', 'THREE_DS_FAILED') THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PROCESSING' END AS status, a.payment_method, a.payment_brand AS card_brand, a.label_currency AS currency, a.label_amount AS amount, l.currency_exponent, a.create_time, COALESCE(a.complete_time, a.update_time, a.create_time) AS complete_time FROM payment_checkout_attempt a JOIN payment_link_checkout_binding b ON b.checkout_session_id = a.checkout_session_id JOIN payment_link l ON l.link_id = b.link_id WHERE b.link_id = #{linkId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_checkout_attempt a JOIN payment_link_checkout_binding b ON b.checkout_session_id = a.checkout_session_id WHERE b.link_id = #{linkId} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT c.collection_id, c.link_id, c.merchant_order_no, b.checkout_session_id, COALESCE(s.checkout_status, 'PENDING') AS payment_status, c.submission_deadline, c.create_time FROM payment_link_collection c LEFT JOIN payment_link_checkout_binding b ON b.collection_id = c.collection_id LEFT JOIN payment_checkout_session s ON s.checkout_session_id = b.checkout_session_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE c.link_id = #{linkId} ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_link_collection WHERE link_id = #{linkId}
mapper.sql:
SELECT e.event_id, e.event_type, e.actor_app_code, e.actor_id, e.reason, e.create_time FROM payment_link_event e WHERE e.link_id = #{linkId} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CHECKOUT:', e.checkout_event_id), e.event_type, 'PAYMENT', NULL, NULL, e.event_time FROM payment_checkout_event e JOIN payment_link_checkout_binding b ON b.checkout_session_id = e.checkout_session_id WHERE b.link_id = #{linkId} AND e.event_type IN ('PAYMENT_SUBMITTED', 'THREE_DS_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED', 'THREE_DS_RETURNED', 'THREE_DS_AUTHENTICATED', 'THREE_DS_FAILED', 'PRE_CHANNEL_FAILED') UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('RESULT:', a.checkout_attempt_id), CASE WHEN a.attempt_status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'PAYMENT_FAILED' END, 'PAYMENT', NULL, NULL, COALESCE(a.update_time, a.create_time) FROM payment_checkout_attempt a JOIN payment_link_checkout_binding b ON b.checkout_session_id = a.checkout_session_id WHERE b.link_id = #{linkId} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.attempt_status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'THREE_DS_FAILED') UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('EXPIRY:', l.link_id), 'LINK_EXPIRED', 'SYSTEM', NULL, NULL, l.expire_time
WHERE l.link_id = #{linkId} AND l.status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.expire_time <= #{now} AND (s.checkout_status IS NULL OR s.checkout_status != 'SUCCESS')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () facts ORDER BY create_time DESC, event_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
